questions.question: A work can be completed by N men in 15 days. 5 men leave the work after 3 days. The remaining work was completed in 18 days. What is the value of N?
questions.solution:
Given:- 

N men can complete the work in 15 days, 

Formula used:- 

work done = efficiency × time

Calculation:- 

Let the efficiency of 1 man be ' E ',

Total work done by N men = N × E × 15 = 15NE

Total work done by N men in 3 days = 3NE

After 3 days 5 men left the work. Remaining workers = N - 5

The remaining work is completed in 18 days by (N - 5) workers,

⇒ 3NE + 18 × (N - 5)× E = 15 NE

⇒ 18(N - 5) = 12N

⇒ 18N - 90 = 12N

⇒ 6N = 90

⇒ N = 15

**The required value of N is 15**.

questions.question: On a certain sum, the interest is compounded annually. If the compound interest for the second year is ₹400 and the compound interest for the fourth year is 576, then what is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
Given:-

C.I. for second year = ₹400

C.I. for fourth year = ₹576

Formula used:- 

Amount(A) = P(1 + r/100)t

C.I. = Amount(A) - Principle(P)

Solution:- 

According to question-

For second year,

⇒ 400 = P(1 + r/100)² - P(1 + r/100)¹

⇒ 400 = P(1 + r/100)[(1 + r/100) - 1] ...(1)

For fourth year,

⇒ 576 = P(1 + r/100)⁴ - P(1 + r/100)³

⇒ 576 = P(1 + r/100)³[(1 + r/100) - 1] ...(2)

From Eqn(2)/Eqn(1)

⇒ 576/400 = (1 + r/100)² 

∵ P and [(1 + r/100) - 1] are eliminated

⇒ 24/20 = 1 + r/100

⇒ r/100 = (24 - 20)/20

⇒ r/100 = 4/20

⇒ r = 20%

**∴ Required rate of interest is 20%.**

The amount in 4 years is 576.

So There is a gap of 2 years.

400 : 576

Square root both sides:

20 : 24

The difference in amount is 24 - 20 = 4

Therefore Rate = 4/20 × 100 =** 20% **

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder, whose height is 10 cm, is 1320 cm². What is the volume of this cylinder? [Use π = frac{{22}}{7}]
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Radius (r)** = **CSA** ÷ (2 × π × h) = 1320 ÷ (2 × 22/7 × 10) = 21 cm.

**Volume (V)** = (**CSA** × r) ÷ 2 = (1320 × 21) ÷ 2 = 13860 cm³.

In m³: 13860 ÷ 10,00,000 = 0.01386 m³.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.01386 m³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Height (h)** = 10 cm, **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 1320 cm², π = 22/7.

**Formula Used:** **CSA** = 2πrh; **Volume (V)** = πr²h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70eeacbf4652248c7454cd1478c6832830547c25adcc8e9d409e5e6ef5406c53.png] 

Find the **Radius (r)** first:

⇒ 1320 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 10

⇒ 1320 = (440/7) × r

⇒ r = (1320 × 7) ÷ 440

⇒ r = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

Now, calculate the **Volume (V)**:

⇒ V = πr²h

⇒ V = (22/7) × 21 × 21 × 10

⇒ V = 22 × 3 × 21 × 10

⇒ V = 13860 cm³

Convert **Volume** to cubic meters (m³):

⇒ 1 m = 100 cm ⇒ 1 m³ = 10,00,000 cm³

⇒ V = 13860 ÷ 10,00,000 m³

⇒ V = 0.01386 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 0.01386 m³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume and Surface Area of Cylinder

For a cylinder of radius r and height h, the Volume is πr²h, the Curved Surface Area is 2πrh, and the Total Surface Area is 2πr(r + h).

Unit Conversion for Volume

To convert cm³ to m³, divide the value by 10⁶ (1,000,000) because (100 cm)³ = 1 m³.

Relation between Volume and CSA

The volume of a cylinder can also be expressed in terms of its curved surface area as Volume = (CSA × r) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: If K1 and K2 are two distinct prime numbers, then what is the product of the highest common factor and the least common multiple of K1 and K2?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For any two numbers, the product of their **Highest Common Factor (HCF)** and **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** is always equal to the **product of the numbers** themselves.

Product = **HCF** × **LCM** = **K₁** × **K₂**.

Since **K₁** and **K₂** are **prime numbers**, this fundamental property remains valid.

**∴ The correct answer is K1 × K2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **K₁** and **K₂** are two **distinct prime numbers**.

**Formula Used:** **HCF(a, b)** × **LCM(a, b)** = **a** × **b**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37db44248dd2ddc792bfdbaf006352c8024d4dd1f9a1f0217664031904a74c94.png] 

⇒ For **distinct prime numbers** **K₁** and **K₂**, the only common factor is **1**.

⇒ **Highest Common Factor (HCF)** = 1

⇒ **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** = **K₁** × **K₂**

⇒ Product of **HCF** and **LCM** = 1 × (**K₁** × **K₂**)

⇒ Product = **K₁** × **K₂**

**∴ The correct answer is K1 × K2.**

**__Additional Information__**

HCF of Prime Numbers

The **HCF** of any two or more **distinct prime numbers** is always **1** as they share no common factors other than unity.

Product Rule for HCF and LCM

For any two positive integers **a** and **b**, **LCM(a, b)** × **HCF(a, b)** = **a** × **b**. This is known as the **Fundamental Property of HCF and LCM**.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are called **co-prime** if their **HCF** is **1**. All **distinct prime numbers** are inherently co-prime to each other.</p

questions.question: On a tree, there are some parrots and some pigeons in the ratio of 7 ∶ 9, respectively. After an hour, 8 parrots fly away, and 6 pigeons and 10 sparrows come and sit on the tree. Number of parrots flew after an hour = 8

Number of pigeons and sparrows sat on the tree = 6 and 10

**Calculation:**

Let the number of parrots initially be 7x and pigeons be 9x.

After an hour, Number of parrots = 7x – 8

After an hour, Number of pigeons = 9x + 6

New Ratio = (7x-8)/(9x+6)=(1)/(4)

⇒ 4(7x - 8) = 9x + 6

⇒ 28x – 32 = 9x + 6

⇒ 28x – 9x = 6 + 32 = 38

⇒ x = (38)/(19) = 2

Number of parrots on tree now = 7 × 2 – 8 = 14 – 8 = 6

Number of sparrows on tree = 10

Ratio of number of parrots to number of sparrows

= (6)/(10) = 3 : 5

**Hence, the ratio of number of parrots to the number of sparrows on tree is 3 : 5.**

Total Cost Price (CP) = 15,000 + 19,000 = 34,000

Profit% = (6,800 ÷ 34,000) × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/921763d5e9a3a4e65b464c9b7d81d36a4c96c7a285d8112000df1d4bd41654c9.png]

⇒ **Profit 2** = 22,300 − 19,000 = 3,300

⇒ **Total Profit** = 3,500 + 3,300 = 6,800

⇒ **Total CP** = 15,000 + 19,000 = 34,000

⇒ **Profit%** = (6,800 ÷ 34,000) × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Overall Profit Calculation

When multiple transactions occur for the same or different items, the **overall profit percentage** is calculated by dividing the sum of individual profits by the sum of individual cost prices.

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit occurs when **Selling Price (SP)** is greater than **Cost Price (CP)**. Loss occurs when CP is greater than SP.</p

questions.question: ______ is the market value of all final goods and services produced within a domestic territory of a country measured in a year.

__
 
• **Gross Domestic Product**

 
 
• GDP measures the monetary value of final goods and services—that is, those that are bought by the final user—produced in a country in a given period of time (say a quarter or a year).
 
• It counts all of the output generated within the borders of a country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Gross margin**

 
 
• Gross margin equates to net sales minus the cost of goods sold. 
 
• The gross margin shows the amount of profit made before deducting selling, general, and administrative (SG&A) costs. 
 
• Gross margin can also be called gross profit margin, which is gross profit divided by net sales
 
 
 
• Net national produc
 
 
• Net national product refers to gross national product, i.e. the total market value of all final goods and services produced by the factors of production of a country or other polity during a given time period, minus depreciation. 
 
 
 
• **Gross National Product** 
 
 
• Gross National Product (GNP) is the total value of all finished goods and services produced by a country's citizens in a given financial year, irrespective of their location. 
 
• GNP also measures the output generated by a country's businesses located domestically or abroad.

• Indigo revolt

 
 
• The Indigo Revolt was a peasant movement and subsequent uprising of indigo farmers against indigo planters that erupted in **1859** in the Chaugacha village of Nadia, Bengal.
 
• The tenants were forced to grow indigo, which was processed in factories set up by indigo planters, almost all of whom were Europeans, in rural areas.

• Mahatma Gandhi wrote Hind Swaraj in 1908 during his return visit to South Africa from India via London by ship.
 
• Hind Swaraj highlights all of Gandhi's basic principles, including the relationship between ends and means, between rights and duties, and between religious communities, as well as his concepts of history, nationality, dissent, education, and technology.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of metalloid?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Boron**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Metalloid:-

 
 
• A metalloid is a type of chemical element that has properties in between, or that are a mixture of, those of metals and nonmetals.
 
• There are 7 metalloids in the modern periodic table.
 
• The seven commonly recognized metalloids are:-
 
• Boron, Silicon (Si), germanium (Ge), arsenic (As), antimony (Sb), tellurium (Te), Polonium(Po), and Astatine(At). Hence, Option 2 is correct.
 
• Metalloids Silicon and Germanium are widely used in the semiconductor industry.
 
• Properties of Metalloids:-
 
 
• Most of their other physical properties and chemical properties are intermediate in nature.
 
• Typical metalloids have a metallic appearance.
 
• They are brittle and only fair conductors of electricity.
 
• Chemically, they behave mostly as nonmetals.
 
• They can form alloys with metals.
 
• They are lustrous in appearance.
 
• Their oxides are amphoteric or weakly acidic.
